name: Haus Josephine
beschreibung: The hotel Haus Josephine is situated in a quiet location on the edge of a village in Tirol. The surroundings offer expansive views of the surrounding mountains. The rooms are traditionally furnished and feature modern amenities such as free Wi-Fi. The hotel's own restaurant serves regional dishes with ingredients from the surrounding area. Nearby, guests will find various leisure activities such as hiking trails and ski areas. The special atmosphere of the house is shaped by the use of wood and cozy furnishings.
